purpose: 前端整页视觉方案预览

variants.name: 暖白纸感
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: full desktop application interface design proposal, warm paper edition.
Primary request: Completely redesign the visible frontend of a lightweight Chinese local work journal app named 日迹. Create one polished high fidelity 1440 by 960 landscape UI mockup, full app filling the image edge to edge. All UI labels must be Simplified Chinese and crisp, correct, comfortably readable.
Input images: Image 1 is an INFORMATION REFERENCE for the existing feature set and sample entries. Redesign the typography, spacing, surfaces, hierarchy, and composition. Do not copy its decorative explanatory text.
Style: exceptionally refined calm productivity desktop app. Warm porcelain background #FAF8F3, off-white sidebar #F1EEE7, white writing surface, graphite text #292E2A, restrained forest green #315A47 as the single primary accent. Delicate borders, subtle soft shadows, clean 10px corner radii. Flat vector interface, generous but purposeful whitespace. No photography, no illustrations.
Composition: a narrow 218px sidebar on the left with 日迹 logo at top, three navigation items 每日记录 (active), 工作报告, 统计概览. Compact October 2026 calendar below, date 9 selected; October 1 is Thursday. Settings at bottom labeled 设置. Main workspace has a slim top toolbar with 搜索记录 and 已保存. Main date title 10月9日, small adjacent 星期五, date navigation arrows and 今天, primary 写记录 action on the right. Under that, broad 720px journal area and compact 285px right column. Keep every panel and primary action fully visible inside the canvas, no clipping or scrolling.
Main journal: one lightweight entry field containing 写下工作进展… and a small plus icon. Heading 工作记录 with a discreet 3 count; three simple filters 全部 进展 备忘 问题. Three chronological items separated by fine rules inside ONE spacious white surface rather than nested bulky cards. First: 14:30, 进展, 产品设计, 完成记录页与报告生成流程设计。 Second: 11:20, 备忘, 团队协作, 确认首版功能范围与协作安排。 Third: 09:15, 问题, 开发, AI 接口异常处理待确认。 Use realistic short Chinese text exactly as specified, no random filler.
Right column: goal panel 当日目标 with 2/4 and a small 50% progress bar; four checkbox rows, first two checked. Exact rows: 完成记录页设计; 梳理报告生成流程; 确认 AI 接口异常处理; 整理本周工作周报. Subtle 添加目标 row. Then a modest 本周统计 panel, three small numbers 4 6 5 with labels 记录天数 工作记录 完成目标; simple seven-day dots. Finally compact 工作报告 panel with three distinct segmented options 日报 周报 月报, 周报 selected, and one visible full-width 生成报告 action. No slogan or explanatory paragraph. Main journal is the clear primary focus.
Typography: modern clean Chinese sans-serif similar to PingFang SC, 14–16px comfortable labels, 16px entry text, 32px date, medium weight titles. Restrained outline icons.
Constraints: show exactly ONE complete app screen. No browser chrome, no mock device, no floating design annotation, no numbered callouts, no English marketing text, no watermarks, no giant metrics, no charts unrelated to daily logging, no gradients. Do not add any unrequested sentences, captions, slogans, helper copy, development notes, or descriptions. The screenshot should look implementable as a real desktop frontend.

variants.name: 冷灰蓝
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one complete high fidelity desktop application screenshot, cool gray and blue design proposal.
Primary request: Redesign the entire frontend of 日迹, a lightweight Chinese work journal desktop app. Use the input screenshot only as an INFORMATION REFERENCE for necessary functions and entries. Make a distinctly new visual composition rather than recoloring the reference. Output a single 1440 by 960 landscape screenshot, edge-to-edge app UI, absolutely no device frame.
Design direction: crisp modern professional desktop tool, tightly organized yet spacious. Cool almost-white #F6F8FB background, pristine white panels, cool graphite #1E293B text, subtle #E3E8F0 borders. Cobalt blue #4263EB reserved for primary action and selected states. Restrained 6–8px rounding, almost no shadows, refined flat outline icons and typographic hierarchy. Comfortable legible Simplified Chinese sans-serif.
Composition: compact 192px left sidebar, a spacious central workspace, and a 310px right inspector under one continuous toolbar. Sidebar top has notebook symbol and 日迹, below vertical navigation 每日记录 active, 工作报告, 统计概览; a compact accurate October 2026 calendar under the nav with date 9 selected and small activity dots, settings gear 设置 at bottom. Do not add branding subtitles. Across the top main area place 每日记录, small 已保存 indicator, and 搜索记录 field.
Main heading uses a compact horizontal date row: 10月9日 in 30px type, 星期五 in subdued text, left/right date arrows, 今天 button, and cobalt 写记录 button on the far right. Central body is one continuous white journal sheet with a restrained header 工作记录 and count 3; tabs 全部 进展 备忘 问题. Within the sheet a slim input row 写下工作进展… with plus icon, followed by three balanced timeline entries, precise Chinese copy:
14:30 / 进展 / 产品设计 / 完成记录页与报告生成流程设计。
11:20 / 备忘 / 团队协作 / 确认首版功能范围与协作安排。
09:15 / 问题 / 开发 / AI 接口异常处理待确认。
Each entry has muted small time, a tiny category chip, readable 16px body text, small trailing more menu. Fine horizontal dividers; no over-nesting or huge blank cards. Leave some clean breathing room below the content.
Right inspector: a simple white 当日目标 block displaying 2/4, a restrained 50% completion indicator, four checkbox rows. First two checked: 完成记录页设计; 梳理报告生成流程. Last two unchecked: 确认 AI 接口异常处理; 整理本周工作周报. Small 添加目标 control. Below is a distinct compact 工作报告 section: segmented 日报 周报 月报, 周报 selected; date range 10月5日 — 10月11日; blue 生成报告 button. Below that a calm single-line or compact block 本周统计 with three values 4 6 5 and labels 记录天数 工作记录 完成目标. The inspector should feel functional and architectural, not promotional.
Text discipline: use ONLY the exact functional labels and sample entries specified above, plus calendar numbers and weekdays. No extra explanatory copy, slogans, English words, help paragraphs, fictional notifications, user avatars, promotional banners, or decorative captions. All text must be correctly spelled, high contrast, sharp and readable. No clipping of panels or long text. Entire screen fits without scroll bars.
Avoid: photographs, texture, gradients, 3D decoration, background wallpaper, oversized dashboard numbers, redundant progress charts, multiple screens, collage, arrows/callouts outside the app, watermark. This should look like a frontend that can be implemented in Vue/Tauri, with consistent alignment and realistic controls.

variants.name: 深色墨绿
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one full desktop frontend design proposal, dark graphite and muted emerald edition.
Primary request: Completely redesign the Chinese work journal app 日迹 into an elegant compact dark desktop interface. Output a single complete 1440 by 960 landscape app screenshot, no device mockup. Use the reference image ONLY as a functional information reference, not as a composition or color template. Preserve navigation, calendar, work entries, daily goals, statistics, and user selectable daily/weekly/monthly reports while redesigning the full page.
Art direction: sophisticated flat native productivity app, charcoal #171C1B background, sidebar #121716, writing surface #1D2421, inspector #19201D, crisp warm white #EDF2EE headings, readable muted gray #A5B3AA secondary text, restrained emerald #6EBB91 selected states and main button. Fine #303B34 borders, subtle 6px corners, no shiny material, no glow, no neon. Comfortable Chinese sans-serif, 15px UI labels, 16px writing text, 34px date title. Disciplined spacing and high text contrast.
Distinct layout: slim 200px sidebar, main journal column approximately 825px, right inspector approximately 315px. A continuous 64px top toolbar with breadcrumb 每日记录, 搜索记录 input, small check icon and 已保存. Sidebar notebook symbol + 日迹, three functional navigation rows 每日记录 active, 工作报告, 统计概览. Compact accurate October 2026 calendar below, date 9 selected, October 1 Thursday, Monday-first grid. Settings gear 设置 anchored at sidebar bottom. No workspace badge and no branding subtitle.
Main journal: date heading 10月9日 with adjacent 星期五. Date arrows and 今天 next to header; an emerald 写记录 action at right. Slim inline entry composer 写下工作进展… with small plus. Under composer a 工作记录 heading with 3 count and restrained underline tabs 全部 进展 备忘 问题. Show exactly three entries as an open continuous timeline, not three nested cards. Small timestamp left, category and topic above, text below. Exact Simplified Chinese:
14:30 · 进展 · 产品设计
完成记录页与报告生成流程设计。
11:20 · 备忘 · 团队协作
确认首版功能范围与协作安排。
09:15 · 问题 · 开发
AI 接口异常处理待确认。
Give each entry measured vertical breathing room with a very subtle divider. Small subdued trailing more menu. No filler or extra notes. The main writing area should feel calm and precise.
Right inspector: a continuous section separated from journal by one thin vertical border rather than a tall stack of floating cards. Heading 当日目标 with 2/4 and 50% slender progress bar. Exactly four checkbox rows, first two checked: 完成记录页设计; 梳理报告生成流程; 确认 AI 接口异常处理; 整理本周工作周报. Subtle 添加目标 below. Further down a quiet 本周统计 section with 4 6 5 and small labels 记录天数 工作记录 完成目标, with seven tiny weekday activity markers. No other chart.
At the BOTTOM of the MAIN JOURNAL COLUMN, place a clearly functional wide report action bar contained within the app: 工作报告 heading, segmented 日报 周报 月报 with 周报 selected, small range 10月5日 — 10月11日, and emerald 生成报告 button aligned right. This bottom report bar is a key compositional difference from the reference. Keep it fully visible and give it sufficient horizontal space so no labels collide. No floating popup.
Constraints: flat UI filling canvas, all controls and content visible without cropping, a real implementable Tauri desktop app appearance. Exact readable Chinese labels only. Do not invent unrequested explanatory sentences, slogans, marketing copy, developer annotations, English labels, long descriptions, random tasks, notification cards, or fake chat content.
Avoid: rounded browser frame, laptop render, background photography, wallpapers, gradients, excessive shadows, vivid neon, giant hero artwork, multiple screens in one image, additional design captions, watermarks. Only ONE app screen.
